title.narrative: Carbon Asset Development Fund (CADF) Multi Donor Trust Fund

description.narrative:
"The CPF concept and development objectives were discussed and approved by the World Bank Board of Directors on September 25comma 2007. The CPF is aimed at promoting demonstrationcomma strategiccomma and transformational programmatic Emission Reduction (ER) activities.
The CPF is composed of two trust funds: the Carbon Asset Development Fund (CADF) and the Carbon Fund. This TFP is for the Carbon Asset Development Fund of the CPF. The CADF provides funding for the development of ER assets and programs through Bank work and recipient executed grant support to client work; administrativeand Trustee services; and to provide technical assistance and capacity building support.
The second trust fundcomma the CPF Carbon Fundcomma will focus on payments for ER credits from Progams developed by Sellers in the Facility. The CPF Carbon Fund will have several tranchescomma and the information on the CADF presented here is based on an assumption of a Euro 350 million first tranche of the CPF Carbon Fund only. See separate TFP for the CPF Carbon Fund for details."
